provider_confirmation: Google Cloud confirmed Text Search at 125/day, both Static Maps request types at 25/day, and the saved key restriction list shows 2 APIs.
cost_estimate: Caps target current global monthly free allowances: autocomplete 10,000; highest details session tier 1,000; Text Search Pro 5,000; Static Maps 10,000. Application counters persist atomically and fail closed. This is not a dollar billing cap; other project usage, changed pricing, taxes or existing charges can affect the bill.
notes: Quotas apply across keys in this project; the API restriction applies to the named key.
Text Search uses only Pro fields, no pagination or per-competitor details. Nine initial area queries per report; further scans are user-triggered.
Provider observations are live and are not stored in the weekly cache. Only independent website audit findings are cached seven days.
Daily and monthly counters require persistent private storage shared by all application workers on one host.
Google Cloud also displays an account verification warning; the account administrator must resolve it.
